name: pi-feishu-notify
description: Bidirectional bridge between pi main conversations and Feishu (Lark): sends a Feishu notification when a pi task finishes, and lets you reply to the notification in Feishu to remotely command that pi session to continue. No lark-cli dependency, built on t
